1.explanation: options.md – documents the “proposal” setting (minimal, smart, fsharp) and shows which pipeline proposals are supported today. configuration.md – explains how to set Prettier options (including "proposal") via .prettierrc or other config files. cli.md – shows how to pass --parser babylon (as in the Playground’s command‐line equivalent). api.md – demonstrates the programmatic API for setting parser and pipeline proposal options. technical-details.md – describes the underlying pipeline‐operator support in the parser plugin and notes minimal versus smart/F# implementations. Together, these files cover how to reproduce the error (by configuring parser and proposal), understand why # isn’t accepted, and see how Prettier currently handles the pipeline operator proposals.
1.bug_scenario: In the Prettier Playground (parser set to “babylon”), entering the pipeline‐operator expression “5 |> # * 2” causes a SyntaxError at the “#” token. The screenshot shows the left‐hand code input pane containing “5 |> # * 2”, the right‐hand output pane reporting “Unexpected character ‘#’ (1:6)” with a red caret under the hash, and the sidebar option picker fixed on the babylon parser. The user expects at least the “minimal” pipeline proposal (but not the “smart” or “fsharp” flavors) to be supported without error.
